source.provenance: Owner-supplied visual reference; original remains local and untracked.
source.role: Primary reference for shell, header, sidebar and panel composition.
source.extraction_method: Manual visual interpretation; not a lossless JPEG conversion or an executable UI.

observed.page_type: Real-estate promotional interface shown on a portrait presentation board.

shell.shape: Large rounded rectangle with a fine white perimeter and curved concave top-center notch.
shell.measurement_note: Bounds are approximate visual estimates relative to the source image, not recovered CSS.
shell.surface: Immersive imagery inside a restrained light frame.

header.placement: Controls follow the upper edge; middle controls occupy the recessed notch.

sidebar.placement: Inside the shell, against its left edge.
sidebar.shape: Two vertically stacked white capsules with rounded ends.
sidebar.primary_items: Icon-led navigation with an active home control and profile image.
sidebar.secondary_items: Utility icons in a separate lower capsule.

observed.typography: Large clean sans-serif display text; smaller compact sans-serif controls and descriptive copy.
panels: Opaque white lower-left information panel with sculpted rounded corners
observed.depth: Photographic background and overlapping panels; it is not a supplied 3D scene.

project_adaptation.status: Proposed design parameters; subject to owner approval.
project_adaptation.page_type: Interactive 3D workflow homepage; clicks open dedicated functional section screens.

palette.note: The owner clarified Anduin brand colors, superseding the initial Android wording. Pale surface colors are project choices.

sidebar.navigation_note: The homepage exposes all nine stages; the compact rail provides shortcuts, not a replacement for the full stage sequence.
sidebar.accessibility_proposed: Every icon gets a visible tooltip, accessible name and keyboard focus state.

homepage_layout.layout_status: Target proportions, not measured output dimensions.
bands: Primary source/review lane: stages 01-05, with Legal review emphasized
cleanliness: Limit each section to one principal 3D object and one optional functional prop
Use one consistent camera and light direction
Keep connective tracks subtle or omit them
Only one hover treatment visible at a time
Remove decorative clutter and unnecessary floating panels

workflow.label: Intake
workflow.purpose: Upload PDF/Word, inspect versions and duplicate candidates.

workflow.label: Source quality
workflow.purpose: Inspect conversion, extraction coverage and unresolved source issues.

workflow.label: Document map
workflow.purpose: Open outline, relation graph and page map linked to source anchors.

workflow.label: Legal review
workflow.purpose: Inspect source-linked findings and record human decisions.

workflow.label: Decision / report
workflow.purpose: Inspect decisions, clarification questions, unresolved items and review report.

workflow.label: Annotation
workflow.purpose: Review paragraph, text box, radio box and checkbox anchors.

workflow.label: Form preview
workflow.purpose: Preview full contract content with approved fields.

workflow.label: Responses
workflow.purpose: Enter, retain and inspect version-linked answers.

workflow.label: PDF QA / export
workflow.purpose: Compare source, annotations, answers and rendered PDF before export.

interaction_contract.idle: Static readable module; no perpetual motion across the page.
interaction_contract.hover: Lift principal object slightly, add restrained blue rim and reveal Open section action; keep text fixed.
interaction_contract.focus: Keyboard focus supplies the same information and a visible outline.
interaction_contract.click: Select the module and open its dedicated functional UI; retain document/version context and a Home return control.
interaction_contract.touch: Show labels and actions without requiring hover; one tap opens the section.
interaction_contract.reduced_motion: Use a static focus/rim treatment instead of lift or rotation.
interaction_contract.status: Only show actual application/job state in future runtime; never infer completion from decorative checkmarks.

review_destination_layout.header: Document/version, source quality and review/job status.
review_destination_layout.center: PDF source and exact highlighted excerpts; both excerpts for contradictions.
review_destination_layout.right: Finding rationale, confirmation question and confirm/dismiss/clarification actions.
review_destination_layout.footer: Open items, coverage, decision history and review gates.
review_destination_layout.note: This functional UI is a click destination, not the homepage image.
